headline: The Workspace area covers seven features marked ready for release; the code review found supporting implementation for three of them (project management, the knowledge-graph visualisation, and chat history sessions) and could not confirm the other four either way.
what_is_there: There is a workspace home for managing projects, an interactive knowledge-graph view with colour-coded entity types, legend and node search, and a full chat-history store behind the sidebar that lists, renames, deletes, pins and searches past conversations. Chat session creation and tracking are also present.
what_is_unclear: Multi-tab chat panels with independent sessions, the folder picker for choosing AI-edit target files, member management with role-based permissions, and workspace trash with restore were not settled — the files examined simply did not cover them, which is not evidence they are missing. The similarity-search side of the knowledge graph and the rename/delete/duplicate project actions were also not directly visible, though the surrounding features were.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to where access control, workspace trash, the AI-edit folder picker and multi-tab chat sessions are implemented, so those four can be confirmed before the release sign-off.
caveat: Some of the reference documentation consulted during the analysis was flagged as describing a different codebase, so it contributed nothing either way for the access control and trash tickets.
